decisions.reason: This 2018 product fits the firm's core glass-wafer and advanced packaging capabilities, so despite limited later website evidence it is likely worth retaining as a niche strategic offering.
Carrier wafers are a practical extension of the firm's established wafer business and should be relatively low-risk to continue serving existing semiconductor customers.

The dedicated 2019 launch of the Cu-interposer glass wafer suggests a serious strategic bet in advanced packaging, so management would likely give it more time unless demand proves clearly insufficient.
An off-the-shelf brand for glass and quartz wafers supports commercialization of the core portfolio and is comparatively easy to maintain unless sales stay too weak.

Glass-based circuit boards appear to be a more speculative adjacency to the firm's main wafer business, so a cautious German industrial management would be more willing to discontinue it if traction remains uncertain.
